# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

- This is a small React 18 application built and served with Vite.
- The main UI component is in `src/App.jsx` with component styles in `src/App.css`.
- Global styles and the React entry point are in `src/index.css` and `src/index.jsx`.
- Static assets belong in `public/` and can be referenced from the site root.

## Development

- Start the development server with `npm start` (port 3000).
- Run tests with `npm test`.
- Create a production build with `npm run build`.
- Keep changes focused and preserve the existing React/Vite setup unless the task requires otherwise.
